title: Karaoke
modeTip:
Quick: live vocal remover in the browser, works instantly on most stereo songs but may leave some vocals.
AI: separates the vocals with an AI model on this computer. The model downloads the first time (30–67 MB, pick it in Settings → Sound); each song is separated once and kept.
Closing the karaoke screen turns karaoke off.
vocalAiHint: AI instrumental already has vocals removed.
simpleModeHint: Turn off Simple mode (Settings → Playback) to use Quick mode and key shift.
noSynced: No synced lyrics for this song yet.
settingsHint: Separated AI instrumentals cached in this browser for instant playback.
clearedEmpty: No cached karaoke data to clear.
cpu: CPU (slow, no WebGPU in this browser)
inRoom: You're in a Nghe chung room: leave it to use karaoke.
holding: The song ended: it plays again for singing once the AI is done (not moving on yet).

model.label: Vocal separation model (AI)
model.hint: Lighter models are faster and suit weak computers; bigger ones separate more cleanly. Changing the model separates each song again once.

spleeter.name: Ultra light: Spleeter
spleeter.desc: About 7× faster than KARA, keeps up even on weak computers. Rougher; some vocals may remain.

kara.name: Light: KARA
kara.desc: Fastest, easiest on the computer. Removes the lead vocal, keeps backing vocals.

kara2.name: Balanced: KARA 2
kara2.desc: Cleaner than KARA, still keeps backing vocals. Made for karaoke.

hq3.name: High quality: Inst HQ 3
hq3.desc: Removes all vocals (backing too), cleanest and heaviest. A graphics card helps.

confirm.title: Separate vocals with AI?
confirm.desc: The AI runs on this computer and may make it slow or warm while it works.
confirm.note: The model downloads the first time. Each song is separated once and kept; a graphics card (WebGPU) makes it much faster. Press Cancel on the progress bar to stop at any time.
